description:
At Higton & Company, we specialize in creating simple, clean, & practical products for mom's with young kids making day to day life easier. From traveling to errands everything is easier with a Higton bag.

Why Partner with Us:

  1. Viral & Stylish Solutions: Our products are designed to make moms' lives more fashionable and less complicated making them easier to market. With over 10 million organic views in the last 3 months on our Instagram alone you will see how easy it is to collab and see success with our products. 
  2. Affiliate Perks: Enjoy generous commissions, free product, exclusive discounts, and early access to our latest releases.
  3. Community Connection: Become part of our community of moms who value quality, style, and practicality.
  4. Flexible Payment Options - We can work with you to get the best timetable and way to be paid quickly.
  5. Tracking & Coupons - Exclusive Coupon Codes Just For Your Audience & Your Affiliate Link

How You Can Get Involved: We're expanding our affiliate program and would love to have you on board. By joining, you'll not only be a part of a brand that cares about moms but also have the chance to earn while sharing products you love.

About The Higton Mini Mae Bag

The Higton Mini Mae bag is the perfect on the go diaper bag for any Mama. It can fit all the essentials while being more functional, making things more convenient, & obviously keeps you looking way better than any bulky diaper backpack does.

FEATURES

Instant Wipes Access With One Hand

3 Card Holders and A Coin Pocket 

Can Wear As A Crossbody Or A Backpack

Ample Storage To Carry Everything From Diapers To Snacks & Obviously Your Wipes

The Fit - 24-48 inch adjustable straps
term_and_condition:
• Attribution hierarchy.
    “Commission is earned only when (i) the customer’s last attributable click is the Affiliate’s unique tracking link and (ii) no promotional code other than (A) the Affiliate’s assigned code(s) or (B) a Company-designated ‘sitewide’ code listed in Exhibit A is used at checkout.”

  • Coupon-code misuse.
    “Promotion or use of any coupon code not assigned to the Affiliate—including codes scraped from or submitted to coupon sites—voids commission on the affected order(s) and may result in reversal, offset against future payouts, and/or program termination.”

  • Clawbacks & fraud.
    “Company may reverse commissions for returns, chargebacks, suspected fraud, tracking manipulation, or violation of Program Policies (including coupon-code rules).”

  • Notice consistency.
    Apply the policy prospectively after notifying affiliates (or immediately if your current terms already allow it). Consistent enforcement helps avoid claims of unfair dealing.

  • Google Ads 
    Using Google Ads & bidding on any brand or product keywords is not allowed and if discovered all pending or future sales and commissions will be withheld resulting in the affiliate relationship being terminated.
